scores.evidence: Each of the 3 can-do objectives has 2 or more graded questions, and each set includes an apply-level item or higher (o1: q4, e1, e2; o2: q2, q3, e3; o3: q5, e6). But o1 lists 「CLAUDE.md・.claude/rules/・CLAUDE.local.md・権限ルール」, while its two exam items test a hook (e2, answer 「フックで自動的に実行させる」) and AGENTS.md loading (e1). Neither of those is among the places o1 names.

hook-predict changed only in its explanation (「Claudeが読むコンテキスト（context）です」); q0 is still an ungraded prediction tied to o3 after the concrete problem in hook-b1. hook-b1 still promises 「何を、どこに、どれだけ書けばよいのか、まず予想してみましょう」 while the prediction covers only blocking `.env`.

Prerequisites 第1回–第5回 are recalled where needed (「第1回と第5回で見たとおり」 in s1-lead, 「第2回で書いた…」 in hook-predict and s4-defs). The changed glossary AGENTS.md entry now gives the same condition as s3-defs (「既定では、作業フォルダーとその上にCLAUDE.mdもCLAUDE.local.mdもないときに読まれます。`.claude/CLAUDE.md` も、CLAUDE.mdに数えます。」).

measure.mjs gives 「prose 2400 (budget 1,200–2,400) · questions 9 · est 19.1 min (must be ≤ 20; estMinutes 19)」, so prose is still exactly at the cap and estMinutes matches. lint --strict reports 0 warnings. The shorter table cells (s2-table 「整形する」, s4-table 「禁止」) lighten the screens, but s3 still holds imports, rules, AGENTS.md, a code block, a diagram and a callout in one segment.

s5-steps is a complete worked example before practice: 6 subgoal-labelled steps (「① コードからわかる行を消す」…「⑥ 自分だけの好みをローカルへ移す」), each with a reason in md and a result in expect (「チームのCLAUDE.mdは2行になります」). No faded example sits between it and the independent 18-line practice.

s1–s4 each end with an inline check that gives feedback on every wrong option. q2 is now a repair item, and q4 asks where a new 10-line rule set belongs. Two items are still partly answerable by recognition: q2's answer is the only option that repeats s1-concat's phrase 「矛盾する2行」, and q5's answer 「判断の材料として読まれ、強制はされない」 restates s4-lead 「参考に判断しますが、必ず守るという保証はありません」.

Every misconception in the brief appears as a distractor, with feedback of 2 sentences or fewer: override vs concatenation (q2 b, e1 a), `@` reducing context (q4 c, e3 a), longer is better or the 200-line limit as a guarantee (q5 b, e6 b), auto mode (e6 d). The deny overclaim is gone. But the 「IMPORTANT」 option is the wrong answer in five items (q0 a, q2 a, q5 a, e3 c, e6 a), so learners can eliminate it by pattern. The 「前の会話を覚えている」 misconception appears only once (q0 c).

s3-diagram now has 5 nodes. Its labels use the text's own terms (「インポート先」「paths: なしのルール」「paths: 付きのルール」), and the caption states the takeaway (「減らせるのは paths: 付きのルールです」). The 2-column tables keep their comparisons: s1-table puts 「届く範囲」 against 「置き場所：ファイル」, and s4-table names a destination for each of the blog's five anti-patterns.

The authentic task is now a 19-line file, and every count agrees (pr-setup 「19行の `CLAUDE.md`」, pr-decide 「19行すべてに」, practice-prompt 「19行分を書きます」). Lines are named by their opening words instead of numbers (「どの行かは、行の書き出しの言葉でメモします」), and hint3 follows the same scheme. practice-answer extracts the procedure with `sed -n '/^## 画面/,$p'`, which works whatever the line count. Its highlight 6–11 covers exactly the four kept items and the comment, which matches practice-answer-why 「残した4つの項目」. The 3-level hint ladder and the 7-item checklist are still there.

summary-points follows the exam; summary-next keeps the reflection question (「ここ1週間で、Claudeに2回以上した同じ説明や直しはありますか」) and now names the next lesson by its real title (「第7回｜手順はスキルに、調べものはサブエージェントに」, the cc-07 draft title). summary-cards has 7 cards.

The changed blocks keep their facts: s1-table still names 「Linuxでは `/etc/claude-code/` のCLAUDE.md」, and s2-table keeps the official pairs (「インデントは2スペース」, 「コミットの前に `npm test` を実行する」). s4-table's labels match the steering post's five anti-patterns in the facts file (「'Never do this'」, 「an API-specific rule without paths」). The new practice-answer runs as written: the `\` continuation and the `/^## 画面/,$p` range copy the heading and its 6 steps.

The changed learner text keeps です・ます (hint3: 「…ローカルへ移します」「今はコマンドだけ残します」, pr-decide: 「…でメモします」). The terse lines in practice-setup are the sample file's own voice, which is intended. lint --strict finds no banned phrase and no long sentence. Wording is left to ja-editor.

The jp locale is complete. s3-diagram's alt now describes exactly what is drawn (startup items and the context, plus path-scoped rules loaded 「一致するファイルを扱うときに」), and the caption is present. Link text says where it goes (「公式ドキュメント（日本語）」).

niceToHave: s4-table (changed): the bare labels 「禁止」 and 「API専用」 lose the condition that decides where a line goes. pr-explain and summary-next send learners to this table to sort their own lines. Not every prohibition can be written as a deny rule (for example a coding-style ban), and a rule for `tests/` is not 「API専用」. Replace row 1 col 1 with 「「絶対に〜しない」操作」 and row 4 col 1 with 「一部のファイル用」. To stay within the 2,400 cap, offset the added characters by changing the caption to 「CLAUDE.mdに書きがちなことの移す先（公式ブログより）」, then re-run measure.mjs.

s1-table (changed): the first column now shows 「自分」 twice, so the scope difference sits only in column 2. Use these rows: [「組織の全員」, 「管理ポリシー：Linuxでは `/etc/claude-code/` のCLAUDE.mdなど」], [「自分（全プロジェクト）」, 「ユーザー：`~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`」], [「チーム（Gitで共有）」, 「プロジェクト：`./CLAUDE.md` か `./.claude/CLAUDE.md`」], [「自分（このプロジェクト）」, 「ローカル：`./CLAUDE.local.md`」].

practice-hint3 (changed; carried mismatch): 「テストの3行は、コマンドの行にまとめます」 does not match practice-answer, which keeps two test items. It also skips the 直す step that s5-steps ② teaches for 「ちゃんと」. Replace it with 「「ちゃんと」の行は「コミットの前に `npm run test:unit` を通す」に直し、残りのテスト2行は1つにまとめます。」

practice-setup (unchanged lines in a changed block, carried): `mkdir cc-practice-06` / `cd cc-practice-06` on separate lines has no guard, so if `cd` fails, `cat > CLAUDE.md` overwrites the current folder's file. Use 「mkdir -p cc-practice-06 && cd cc-practice-06」 on the first line, then 「git init」.

s3-defs and glossary AGENTS.md (unchanged, carried): 「ほかのAIコーディングツールと共有する指示のファイル（v2.1.277以降）」 attaches the version to the file, but the audit says reading AGENTS.md requires v2.1.277. Consider 「ほかのAIコーディングツールと共有する指示のファイル。Claude Codeはv2.1.277以降で読みます。」
glossary AGENTS.md (unchanged, carried): unlike s3-defs, it does not say that `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` does not count. Append 「`~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` は数えません。」
hook-b1 (unchanged, carried): so the promise matches the single predict question, replace 「何を、どこに、どれだけ書けばよいのか、まず予想してみましょう。」 with 「まず、`.env` の読み取りをどう止めるか、予想してみましょう。」

check-quiz e6 option a (unchanged, carried): 「IMPORTANT」 is the wrong answer in five items. Replace e6 a with md 「「前のセッションで頼んであるから、もう覚えているよ」」 and feedback 「セッションは毎回まっさらに始まり、前の会話は引き継がれません。止めたい操作は、拒否ルールやフックで決めておきます。」
practice-steps pr-permissions expect (unchanged, carried): Claude may write the rules in other forms. Use 「拒否ルールとして、`.env` の読み取りと `git push` を止める2行が見つかります（例：`Read(./.env)`、`Bash(git push *)`）。」
Budget guard: prose is at 2400 of the 2,400 cap (measure.mjs). Offset any text a fix adds with an equal cut.
summary: Verification round: review-scope exited 0 with 12% of parts changed (10 of 47 blocks). The one open must-fix is resolved: s3-diagram now merges CLAUDE.md, imports and unscoped rules into one startup node with its own edge to the context, and the alt no longer mentions auto memory. Every changed block was reviewed in full. The switch to a 19-line practice file is consistent across pr-setup, pr-decide, the prompt hint, hint3 and the answer, whose sed range and highlight 6–11 are correct. No regressions rise to a must-fix. The shortened s4-table and s1-table labels and the hint3/answer mismatch are listed in niceToHave. All 13 criteria are 3 or above, mean 3.38, lint and validate clean, est 19.1 min with prose at the 2,400 cap.
